fieldValues.title: Keep the handbook true
fieldValues.description: Weekly: compare every handbook stage, chapter and element with the clerk code, tests, programme records and boards since the last run; correct the handbook records through the srs CLI and render; open one clerk PR; file issues for drift outside the handbook; write a run report.
fieldValues.done_when: One clerk PR (or a no-change report) whose render check passes, every changed claim cites its evidence, issues filed for what the handbook cannot fix, and a run report with What we learned.
